clips.text: Nvidia's new interim CEO isn't a famous founder. She's the person who has run its money since 2013.
She became Nvidia's chief financial officer back in September 2013.
Since then, yearly revenue grew from about four billion dollars to nearly two hundred sixteen billion.
Now the board is searching for a permanent CEO, and says it will consider insiders and outsiders.
Follow, and I'll tell you the moment Nvidia names its next permanent boss.
